column1: # Git-backed components of the SignCollect web interface.
#   webdir<TAB>repo<TAB>branch
# webdir is the directory under /web on production. The deployed tree is kept
# path-identical to production so menu links resolve unchanged - the menu in
# signlab_signCollect-v2 hardcodes /videoFix/, /studioIndex/, /hh/ etc.
# Clone target is build/<repo> (existing convention), deploy target is
# /web/<webdir>. Branch is what production actually has checked out:
# signlab_hh is on master, the rest on main.
# Not listed, deliberately:
#   signlab_sCAPI  - /api is Alias'd to /web/zin/api by signcollect-mounts.conf,
#                    so the API ships inside signlab_zin. sCAPI is the separate
#                    api.signcollect.nl service and is out of scope here.
#   mocap*         - removed from the demo by design (see remove-mocap-tile.py).
# annotation-editors is the source of truth for subBeta8 and 3DAnn3; zin and hh
# link to it rather than carrying their own copies. animMIDI (the repo is named
# sC-Animation-PP) serves the assets those editors load by absolute path -
# environment.envbin and the 34MB PalmerPolo avatar - so the editors break
# without it.
